meta.title: Optimize ONNX ReferenceEvaluator Resize performance with vectorized numpy implementation
meta.body_summary: Replace element-by-element iteration in ONNX Resize with vectorized numpy implementation, achieving ~7,400x speedup for large tensors and cutting time from ~24min to 0.2s.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot vectorized ONNX Resize with numpy; maintainer requested removal of old code; CI tests showed correctness regressions in half_pixel_symmetric; PR closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 901 changed lines in a single file, this is a medium-sized performance refactor. As a numerical optimization PR, it was closed—not merged—due to regression test failures and lint issues rather than scale.

review_details.concern_detail: Two ONNX backend reference tests (test_resize_downsample_scales_linear_half_pixel_symmetric_cpu and test_resize_upsample_scales_linear_half_pixel_symmetric_cpu) failed, showing the vectorized implementation produces different outputs for linear half_pixel_symmetric interpolation mode; this violates backward compatibility.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces Resize operator execution from ~24 minutes to ~0.2 seconds for a (1,384,40,40) tensor, with ~7,400x speedup.
review_details.rejection_signals: CI tests revealed regression in half_pixel_symmetric; lintrunner flagged many whitespace issues; maintainer requested removal of old implementation; PR closed without merge likely due to unresolved test failures.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot attempted a numerical optimization (vectorized interpolation) but introduced a correctness bug in the half_pixel_symmetric mode, failing ONNX reference tests. This highlights a boundary where the agent could not fully validate edge cases in the interpolation algorithms.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer justinchuby reviewed the code and requested removal of the old slow implementation.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI tests automatically detected regression in two resize tests; also lintrunner flagged whitespace and formatting violations.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provided benchmark table with specific tensor sizes and times, but the failing ONNX reference tests show the performance optimization does not produce identical outputs, making benchmark claims unreliable.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After Copilot attempted to fix, the CI tests still failed; no further commits resolved the issue; PR was closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: In onnx/reference/ops/op_resize.py, replaced the original element-by-element interpolation loop with vectorized batch processing using numpy meshgrid and broadcasting, while handling multiple coordinate transformation modes.
change_trajectory: Added vectorized functions with fallback for non-linear modes
Fixed linear interpolation detection and removed duplicate code
Removed original slow implementation and replaced with comprehensive vectorized approach per maintainer request
Applied lint suggestions and formatting fixes from github-actions
Overall, the vectorized approach introduced but failed ONNX reference tests for half_pixel_symmetric, leading to closure

review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed old implementation and claimed behavioral compatibility.

review_signals.summary: Asked to also remove the old _interpolate_nd_with_x implementation.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed it in subsequent commit.

review_signals.summary: Provided many style/lint suggestions (blank line whitespace, formatting) for the new code.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot applied some fixes in later commits.

review_signals.summary: Reported 2 test failures with mismatched outputs for half_pixel_symmetric resize tests.
Flagged multiple trailing whitespace violations (RUFF, editorconfig) in the new code.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with vectorized implementation.
Maintainer justinchuby requested removal of old slow implementation and ensure behavioral equivalence.
Copilot responded by removing old code and claiming same behavior.
CI detected regression in half_pixel_symmetric tests and lint issues.
Maintainer also requested removal of old _interpolate_nd_with_x.
Copilot removed that, but no further commits addressing test failures.
